description: This Java class 'DOMSettingsUnmarshaller' parses XML nodes to populate a 'Settings' object with configuration data such as window properties, file paths, options, table display settings, logger configurations, clipboard formats, and icons. It contains multiple private methods for unmarshalling specific sections of the XML structure.

classes.name: DOMSettingsUnmarshaller
classes.description: A final class responsible for unmarshalling XML nodes into a Settings object.

methods.name: unmarshallSettings
methods.description: Main method that processes the root XML node and delegates to specific unmarshalling methods based on child node names.

methods.name: unmarshallWindow
methods.description: Unmarshals window-related settings such as size, location, maximized state, and split pane location.

methods.name: unmarshallFiles
methods.description: Unmarshals file paths for ECU definitions, image directory, and repository directory.

methods.name: unmarshallOptions
methods.description: Unmarshals various user options like warnings, debug mode, version, display settings, and scales.

methods.name: unmarshallTableDisplay
methods.description: Unmarshals table display settings including font, cell size, and colors.

methods.name: unmarshallColors
methods.description: Unmarshals color settings for various UI elements.

methods.name: unmarshallLogger
methods.description: Unmarshals logger configuration including protocol, window size, tabs, plugin ports, and debug level.

methods.name: unmarshallColor
methods.description: Creates a Color object from XML attributes r, g, b.

methods.name: unmarshallClipboardFormat
methods.description: Unmarshals clipboard format settings and table headers.

methods.name: unmarshallIcons
methods.description: Unmarshals icon scale settings for editor and table icons.
